title: Washington Fishing Map
identified: 2026-10-18, named by Daniel when asking for improvements
what: Full-bleed Washington map with two modes. Recent reports: eight SW Washington salmon waters (Kalama rated Slow from the source's own word; Washougal counts-only), rated from sourced catch reports, plus WDFW weekly creel counts. Typical season: 540 piers, boat launches and shore access sites statewide colored by the WA Fish Map app's seasonal timing for the chosen species, with recent WDFW creel counts on nine matched sites. Counts and timing never mix with ratings.
